scenes.heading: INT. THE OLD HOUSE - NIGHT
scenes.purpose: Establish the narrator's confessional address, dreadfully nervous yet insisting he is sane, and his disease-sharpened acute hearing as the frame for the story.
visual_beats: Dim oppressive corridor of weathered wood and plaster with shuttered windows
Narrator stands composed yet taut addressing unseen listener
He touches his ear lightly, eyes sharp
He steadies himself into calm persuasive delivery

scenes.heading: INT. THE OLD MAN'S CHAMBER - NIGHT
scenes.purpose: Introduce the old man asleep and the origin of the murderous idea: not gold or insult but the vulture eye that makes the narrator's blood run cold.
visual_beats: Pitch-dark bedroom with heavy bed, fastened shutters, modest treasures
Old man frail in plain nightshirt lies asleep, filmy pale-blue vulture eye closed
Narrator in doorway staring toward the bed as blood runs cold at the thought of the eye
He does not approach the treasures

scenes.heading: INT. THE OLD MAN'S CHAMBER - DAY
scenes.purpose: Show the narrator's daytime performance of extreme kindness and hearty unsuspicious manner during the week before the murder.
visual_beats: Morning light through unshuttered gaps
Old man sits up in bed in neat nightshirt
Narrator enters boldly with hearty manner and kind smile
Old man answers with frail nod; narrator withdraws unsuspiciously

scenes.heading: INT. THE CHAMBER DOOR AND LATCH - NIGHT
scenes.purpose: Demonstrate the narrator's cunning stealth: turning the latch oh so gently and taking an hour to thrust head and closed dark lantern into the opening.
visual_beats: Aged wooden door and metal latch, corridor side dim
Narrator in dark night attire holds fully closed tin dark lantern
Latch turns with extreme softness; door opens only a crack
Closed lantern slides through then head thrusts in very very slowly

scenes.heading: INT. THE OLD MAN'S CHAMBER - NIGHT
scenes.purpose: Show the seven-night ritual of the single thin lantern ray falling on the always-closed Evil Eye, making the work impossible until the eye is open.
visual_beats: From the crack: old man asleep on heavy bed, eye closed
Narrator's head and closed lantern in the opening
Lantern undone cautiously; hinges creak; single thin ray on closed vulture eye
Eye stays shut; narrator withdraws lantern and closes door without sound

scenes.heading: INT. THE OLD MAN'S CHAMBER - DAY
scenes.purpose: Reaffirm the morning bold hearty inquiries so the old man could never suspect the midnight visits.
visual_beats: Daybreak; narrator in neat daytime clothes enters boldly
Hearty inquiry how the night was passed
Old man answers without suspicion
Narrator's manner courageously kind

scenes.heading: INT. THE CHAMBER DOOR AND LATCH - NIGHT
scenes.purpose: Eighth night: extreme caution slower than a watch hand, private triumph chuckle, steady push into pitch darkness, and the thumb slip on the tin fastening.
visual_beats: Narrator in dark night attire works latch more slowly than a watch minute hand
He chuckles under his breath at his own sagacity
Door pushed on steadily into room black as pitch with shutters fastened
Thumb slips upon the tin fastening of the closed dark lantern

scenes.heading: INT. THE OLD MAN'S CHAMBER - NIGHT
scenes.purpose: Climax of the murder: old man's cry and hour of listening terror, spider-thread ray on the open Evil Eye, rising heartbeat tattoo, yell, leap, smothering under the heavy bed, and confirmation of stone death.
visual_beats: Old man springs up in heavy bed, pale-blue filmy eye wide, crying Who's there?
Narrator freezes motionless in the opening for a whole hour
Old man sits up listening; low stifled groan of mortal terror
Death's black shadow seems to envelop the sitting figure
Single dim spider-thread ray falls full upon the wide-open vulture eye
Nothing else of the face lit; narrator's fury rises as he holds ray steady
Heartbeat tattoo quickens and loudens under dreadful house silence
Loud yell; lantern thrown fully open; sudden full beam; leap into room
Old man shrieks once only; dragged to floor; heavy bed pulled over him
Narrator smiles gaily; muffled heart beats many minutes then ceases
Bed removed; hand held on heart many minutes; stone stone dead; eye will trouble no more

scenes.heading: INT. THE OLD MAN'S CHAMBER - NIGHT (LATER)
scenes.purpose: Wise concealment: clinical dismemberment, body parts deposited between scantlings under three replaced planks with no stain, tub catching all, then four o'clock bell and street-door knocking.
visual_beats: Night waning; lantern light; narrator slightly disordered from labor works hastily in silence
Dismemberment of corpse—head arms legs—clinical not lingered upon
Tub stands ready off main floor and catches all
Three planks taken up; parts deposited between scantlings
Boards replaced so cunningly no human eye could detect wrong; no blood-spot
Soft self-satisfied ha ha
Four o'clock still dark as midnight; distant bell; firm knocking below

scenes.heading: INT. THE STREET DOOR - NIGHT
scenes.purpose: Narrator opens with light heart to three suave police officers deputed after a neighbour heard a shriek; he smiles, explains the shriek as a dream, and invites full search.
visual_beats: Heavy period street door in pre-dawn dark
Narrator comes down with light heart, clothes ordered, no visible stain
Three officers in matching dark civic coats enter with perfect suavity
Narrator smiles and bids them welcome and search well

scenes.heading: INT. THE OLD HOUSE - NIGHT
scenes.purpose: Narrator leads the officers all over the house with singular ease; his confident manner convinces them; rooms appear undisturbed.
visual_beats: Narrator leads three officers through quiet corridors and modest rooms
Lantern or candle light moving with them
His manner singularly at ease
Officers remain composed and convinced by his confidence

scenes.heading: INT. THE OLD MAN'S CHAMBER - NIGHT
scenes.purpose: Triumphant seating of officers directly above the concealed corpse; rising auditory hallucination of the heartbeat; narrator's progressive breakdown from ease to pallor, pacing, foaming raving, and final shrieking confession.
visual_beats: Chamber shown: treasures secure, heavy bed restored, floorboards innocent
Narrator brings chairs; seats officers; places own seat on the very spot above the corpse
Officers chat of familiar things; narrator answers cheerily at first
Narrator grows pale; head aches; ringing becomes distinct low dull quick tattoo
Officers hear it not; continue pleasant chat and smiles
Narrator talks more quickly and vehemently; rises; violent gesticulations
Paces with heavy strides; foams raves swears; swings and grates chair on boards
Noise louder louder louder over all; hypocritical smiles unbearable
Final shriek: Villains! dissemble no more! tear up the planks! beating of his hideous heart!
Points wildly at the spot; officers freeze, smiles gone, staring at floorboards and him
